Horizontal rule produces a separator in output

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<p>Above</p><hr><p>Below</p>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
```
